narrative: The account book at the lodging, one new line. No coffer is written above or below it. No face. The Christmas line from Monday. Expected is still there. The place for a sum is blank. Nothing is struck in tonight, because nothing was written to strike. The foot of the page. No total. No second column married to the first.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Entered 38s and closed the book on a blank.
